## Exercises

### 53.1 Match the problems 1-6 with the responses a-f.
1. {_} 4 My husband and I are so busy at {_} I always seem to pick boyfriends work that we seem to be drifting {_} who let me down. What can I do? apart. What should I do?
2. {_} 5 How can I finish with my {_} I'm 35. Isn't it time I was thinking boyfriend without hurting his {_} of settling down? feelings too much?
3. {_} 6 What can I do to get over the {_} I've decided never to get married. break-up of my marriage? {_} Do you agree with my friends that I still love my wife {_} I will be missing out on a lot?

- a) Become friends first - then you should know what he is really like before you take things any further.
- b) The right time can arrive at any age - when you meet the right person.
- c) Why not take up some new hobby together?
- d) Why make such a major decision about your future now? You may feel very differently in a few years' time.
- e) Time should slowly make things better for you.
- f) Could you try to make him want to split up with you first?

### 53.2 Rewrite these sentences replacing the phrasal verbs with another phrasal verb from the opposite page, so that the sentences keep the same meanings.
1. My sister and her husband broke up last year. {__}
2. Milly was very upset when her boyfriend broke off with her. {__}
3. We had been drifting apart for a long time, so it was better to separate properly. {__}

### 53.3 Complete these sentences using appropriate phrasal verbs from the opposite page.
1. Whenever I quarrel with my girlfriend I can't wait to {_} again.
2. We were all very shocked when Emily left her husband and {_} her boss. After leaving school my best friend got a glamorous job travelling all over the world, but now all she wants to do is get married and {_} somewhere.
3. I am absolutely sure that I can trust him and that he will never {_} me
4. It was so embarrassing when I spilt tomato soup all over my boss - I'm sure I'll never {_} 1t
5. I think that children who are educated at home {_} on the opportunity to make friends of their own age.
6. Sally is determined to marry someone who is both handsome and rich and she'll never less. {__}
7. I can't understand why my girlfriend decided to {_} our relationship. UP Look at the problem pages in an English language magazine. Copy down any sentences that you find FOLLOW containing phrasal verbs.

### 53.2
1. My sister and her husband **split up** last year.
2. Milly was very upset when her boyfriend **finished with her**. *Or* Milly was very upset when her boyfriend **broke up** with her.
3. We had been **growing apart** for a long time, so it was better to separate properly.

1 make up · 2 ran off with · 3 settle down · 4 let, down · 5 live, down · 6 miss out · 7 settle for · 8 break off
